title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) Falls 0.2% to $403.30 (Oct 29)
summary: Tesla (TSLA) closed at $403.30 on Oct 29, down 0.23%, holding up better than the Nasdaq as Alphabet's results weighed on tech stocks.
body_markdown:
## Why Tesla Stock Fell


Financial media tied the small dip to a sector-wide pullback rather than to Tesla news of its own. According to[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/538805bb-efe9-3dce-af1e-783f67bd3993/tesla-stock-gets-dragged-down.html) , Tesla was dragged down by weakness in Alphabet, as many tech stocks were weak after Google's parent company reported[disappointing third-quarter numbers](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/alphabet-q3-earnings-miss-sinks-stock-reignites-ai-capex-fears-googl-nasdaq-futures/) .


Merger talk stayed in the background. As reported by[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/musk-says-tesla-spacex-merger-144235636.html) , Elon Musk said on SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call on October 20 that combining SpaceX and Tesla would be "a good idea," while warning that a Tesla vote would need "a 50% vote of all shares, not just those who vote," which he called "quite a high hurdle." Both companies have formed special committees of independent directors, and the committees have not agreed on terms, the report said.


On the legal front,[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-wins-south-korea-fsd-144722335.html) reported that a Seoul district court rejected a complaint from 88 Tesla owners seeking refunds for the company's Full Self-Driving software. The judges said Tesla was obliged to provide additional functions only if the technology advanced and regulators approved, according to the report.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- The Seoul verdict supports Tesla's position that Full Self-Driving was not sold as guaranteed fully autonomous driving, GuruFocus noted.
- Per[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-just-gained-13-month-173432877.html) , active FSD subscriptions rose to 1.74 million from 1.04 million in the third quarter, and the car backlog reached a four-year high.
- Tesla closed 1.15 percentage points ahead of the Nasdaq Composite in a session of broad tech selling.


### Risks


- Third-quarter GAAP net income fell to $787 million from $1.37 billion, and free cash flow dropped to $1.53 billion from $3.99 billion, according to TIKR.
- No terms exist for a SpaceX combination, and a Tesla vote would need a majority of all outstanding shares, per 24/7 Wall St.
- FSD refund disputes in China and possible US lawsuits over how Tesla markets the software are still pending, GuruFocus reported.


TIKR lists Tesla's annual shareholder meeting for December 3, with no merger item on its agenda.
